site_title.description: The title of your DokuWiki installation (shown in browser tabs and page headers).

base_url.description: The full base URL (including trailing slash) where this DokuWiki instance is accessible.

data_dir.description: Absolute path to the data directory (must be writable by the web server).

config_dir.description: Optional absolute path to the config directory (if different from the default 'conf' subdirectory of data_dir).

start_namespace.description: Default namespace used when no namespace is specified (e.g., 'start' means the page 'start' in the 'start' namespace).

use_acl.description: Enable Access Control List (ACL) permissions system to restrict read/edit/upload/delete/admin actions per user/group.

default_user_level.description: Default permission level for unauthenticated users (0=read only, 10=edit, 20=upload, 40=delete, 100=admin).

syntax_mode.description: Default syntax highlighting engine ('dokuwiki' for built-in, or 'geshi' if geshi plugin is enabled).

recent_changes_count.description: Number of recent changes to display on the recent changes page and feed.

admin_items_per_page.description: Number of items (users, ACL entries, etc.) to show per page in the admin interface.

allow_register.description: Allow public self-registration. When true, new users can register via the web UI (subject to email validation if configured).

notify_enabled.description: Enable email notifications for page changes (requires working SMTP setup).

smtp_enabled.description: Enable custom SMTP for outgoing emails (notifications, registration emails).

smtp_port.description: SMTP server port (common: 587 for TLS, 465 for SSL, 25 for unencrypted).

smtp_user.description: SMTP authentication username (leave empty if not required).

smtp_pass.description: SMTP authentication password (store securely; never commit to version control).

media_extensions.description: List of allowed file extensions for media uploads. Case-insensitive.

items.description: A single allowed file extension (e.g., 'svg' or 'webp').
